facts.fact: WardheerNews states that on 2 March 2025 access to its own site was blocked on Hormuud Telecommunications' network across Mogadishu, Hirshabelle, Galmudug, South West State and Jubaland, which it attributes to the government.
WardheerNews states that political commentator and journalist Ali Adan Mumin was arrested on 1 March 2025 on charges of threatening national security and defaming government officials.
